title: randomise
description: FSL Randomise: feeds the 4D projected FA data into GLM modelling and thresholding in order to find voxels which correlate with your model

base_name.description: The rootname that all generated files will have.
base_name.title: Base name

demean.description: Demean data temporally before model fitting.
demean.title: Demean

num_perm.description: Number of permutations (default 5000, set to 0 for exhaustive).
num_perm.title: Num perm

one_sample_group_mean.description: Perform 1-sample group-mean test instead of generic permutation test.
one_sample_group_mean.title: One sample group mean

output_type.description: 'nifti' or 'nifti_pair' or 'nifti_gz' or 'nifti_pair_gz'. Fsl output type.
output_type.title: Output type

p_vec_n_dist_files.description: Output permutation vector and null distribution text files.
p_vec_n_dist_files.title: P vec n dist files

seed.description: Specific integer seed for random number generator.
seed.title: Seed

show_info_parallel_mode.description: Print out information required for parallel mode and exit.
show_info_parallel_mode.title: Show info parallel mode

show_total_perms.description: Print out how many unique permutations would be generated and exit.
show_total_perms.title: Show total perms

tfce2D.description: Carry out threshold-free cluster enhancement with 2d optimisation.
tfce2D.title: Tfce2d

var_smooth.description: Use variance smoothing (std is in mm).
var_smooth.title: Var smooth

vox_p_values.description: Output voxelwise (corrected and uncorrected) p-value images.
vox_p_values.title: Vox p values
